responsibility: This file implements the non-inline behavior of GCC’s sreal approximate-real number type. It provides dumping and debug hooks, conversions to integer and double, arithmetic operators with normalization and bounded exponent/significand behavior, and stream_in/stream_out support through the generic data-streamer layer, plus selftests for arithmetic and shifting. Its responsibility is concrete arithmetic and serialization for the lightweight analysis-oriented sreal type, not general REAL_VALUE_TYPE handling.
same_name_distinction: This implementation file provides sreal’s non-inline behavior from gcc/sreal.h: arithmetic operator bodies, conversion/dumping routines, generic streamer serialization, and selftests. In contrast, gcc/sreal.h mainly defines the compact number representation and the inline normalization, comparison, shift, and convenience operators.
